title: Permission rules on Write(path), Glob(path), or a .claudeignore file are accepted but never enforced
symptoms: Claude writes into a folder covered by a Write(docs/**) deny rule
Startup warning that a rule is not matched by file permission checks (v2.1.210 and later)
Files listed in .claudeignore are still read
cause: File permission checks consult only Edit(path) and Read(path) rules. Path rules on Write, NotebookEdit, Glob, or MultiEdit load without error and are ignored, and a .claudeignore file has no effect; before v2.1.210 there was no warning.
fix: Use Edit(path) for anything that writes and Read(path) for anything that reads or lists, and move .claudeignore entries into Read deny rules.
affected: Claude Code permission rules, as of 2026-10; startup warning since v2.1.210
